names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 octombrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Luchian preotul»; the life on the same site spells it Lucian.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Λουκιανός ο ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος της Εκκλησίας της Αντιοχείας», with the rank word and the see left off.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1381, «Лукиан Антиохийский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the two rank words left off; the day line gives «Лукиана, пресвитера Антиохийского».
Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first entry for 15 October old style as the Православни подсетник prints it, «1. Преп. муч. Лукијан презв. Антиохијски», with the rank words left off.

death.note: Two calendars print two years and nothing chooses between them. The Russian day line gives «Прмч. Лукиана, пресвитера Антиохийского (312)»; the Ohrid Prologue closes its paragraph «Пострада 7. јануара 311. године», he suffered on 7 January 311. The Greek and Romanian pages give no year at all. Both calendars agree that he died the day after communing at Theophany, which is 7 January old style, so the disagreement is about the year and not about the day.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 октября ст. ст. — «Прмч. Лукиана , пресвитера Антиохийского (312).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon standing immediately before this line, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The space before the comma is the page's own. The day's polyeleos icon stands before the next entry, Athanasius of Kovrov, and is that line's alone.

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Greek and the Romanian, and the same man. Three things stand on this page and on no other the folder cites. **Edessa**: orphaned at twelve, he gave his property to the poor and went to Edessa to the confessor Macarius, under whose guidance he read the Scriptures diligently and learned the ascetic life — neither the Romanian nor the Greek account has that stage. **The hidden Bible**: the complete corrected Greek text he made was, during his confession, walled up, and was found under Saint Constantine the Great. **Nine years**: he is put in the Nicomedia prison under Diocletian's persecution and strengthens the Christians there «в течение 9 лет», for nine years, before dying of torture and hunger. It gives the year 312 against the Ohrid Prologue's 311, and the two are now in `dates`. It agrees with the Romanian life on the Liturgy served on his own breast and on the thirty days in the sea and the dolphins, and differs from the Greek page in naming Diocletian's persecution rather than Diocletian as his arrester.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 15 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Luchian preotul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Λουκιανός ο ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος της Εκκλησίας της Αντιοχείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: of Samosata in Syria, who divided his inheritance among the poor at twelve, corrected and completed the versions of the Septuagint, Aquila and Symmachus against the original, was ordained presbyter at Antioch and died of starvation in prison at Nicomedia under Diocletian. The page gives no year and the folder has no `dates`, and none is proposed. **The «Σοφιστής και συγγραφέας της αρχαιότητας (120 - 200 μ.Χ.)» line above the life is saint.gr's note on the name Lucian** — the pagan sophist Lucian of Samosata — and it is a near-collision with the saint, who really is of Samosata, so it is named here to be sure that nothing in this row came from it. An apolytikion and a kontakion are taken and both name him; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», Ἦχος πλ. α' «Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον», also names him and is not drafted. Note that the page attributes one of the versions he corrected to «του Διοκλητιανού», where the usual name is Theodotion; it is quoted and not corrected. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.10.2026 (15. октобар ст. ст.) — „1. Преп. муч. Лукијан презв. Антиохијски.“
source.note: The Prologue is the first of the day's two entries and runs to a full paragraph; the page gives no typikon rank, so none is recorded. It also carries a hymn of its own, the Prologue's verses («Лукијан премудри, подвижник и књижник…»), which are the Prologue's poem for the day rather than a service text, and are not drafted as a troparion.

attestations.note: The Ohrid Prologue tells the same passion as the Romanian life and adds four things to it. **The forty soldiers**: on the road to Nicomedia he turned forty soldiers to the faith of Christ by his counsels, «И сви мученички скончаше», and all of them ended as martyrs. **The two boys**: in that persecution not even small children were spared, and two boys who would not eat of the idol sacrifices were thrown into a scalding bath and gave up their souls in the torment. **The living altar in his own words**: «Окружите мене, и будите црква» — surround me and be the church — and then «На прси моје положите, нека буде живи престо живоме Богу!». **The year and the day**: «Пострада 7. јануара 311. године». It also quotes John Chrysostom on his despising of hunger, names Pancratius the envious heretical priest who betrayed him, and names Anthimus of Nicomedia and Peter of Alexandria as the two already tortured when his own name went on the emperor's list — which is where the folder's two existing `related` rows come from on this calendar as well. It gives Maximian as the persecuting emperor, as the Romanian life does, where the Greek page gives Diocletian.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge Sfinte Mucenice Luchian, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Luchian preotul

english.text: Sharer of the apostles’ ways and successor to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, an ascent to contemplation. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in the faith unto blood, O holy martyr Lucian, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Θείω Πνεύματι, λελαμπρυσμένος, γνῶσιν ἔνθεον, ἐταμιεύσω, καὶ τῆς πίστεως τὸν λόγον ἐτράνωσας, ὅθεν Μαρτύρων ἀλείπτης γενόμενος, Λουκιανὲ ἐν ἀθλήσει ἠρίστευσας. Μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first of three hymns on the page of «Άγιος Λουκιανός ο ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος της Εκκλησίας της Αντιοχείας», and it names him.

english.text: Made bright by the divine Spirit, you stored up godly knowledge and made plain the word of the faith; and so, having become a trainer of martyrs, Lucian, you proved best in the contest. Glorious Martyr, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὸv ἐν ἀσκήσει τὸ πρότεροv λαμπρυνθέντα, καὶ ἐν ἀθλήσει τὸ δεύτερον φαιδρυvθέντα, πάντες ὡς φωστῆρά σε φαιδρότατον, Λουκιανὲ τοῖς ὕμvοις, ἐνδόξως σε γεραίρομεν. Πρεσβεύων μὴ παύσῃ ὑπὲρ πάντων ἠμῶv.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὴν ἐν πρεσβείαις — on the same page, and it names him and no other saint.

english.text: You who were made bright first in ascesis and then made radiant in the contest — we all honour you gloriously with hymns, Lucian, as a most radiant luminary. Do not cease interceding for us all.
